reply_text:

㊬ (job states, checked just now)
- codex-6's job on re-landing `e4e8b8b` (`…6407fc31`) is **done**. Its result went to codex-17.
- codex-8's bisect of the 12 failing tests (`…7b6e4adb`) is still **running**.

🈯 (the open question) I also asked you one thing: does codex-8 stay on that bisect, given my notes say it's one of your reserved seats? If you want me to watch these jobs or check codex-17's handling of codex-6's result, say so and I'll park on them.
